exposure: Indications for relaparotomy (hemorrhage, peritonitis/sepsis, burst abdomen, intestinal obstruction)
Intraoperative findings during relaparotomy (pelvic hematomas, uterine wound dehiscence, generalized peritonitis, bowel obstruction)
cohort: A total of 110 women who underwent relaparotomy after obstetric surgeries in two tertiary care hospitals in Bihar, India.
finding: Relaparotomy after obstetric surgeries, although uncommon, is associated with significant maternal morbidity and mortality, with hemorrhage and sepsis being the predominant causes.
